senses.gloss: ch. same, to strike, knock, push down.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 140:5">Targ. Ps. CXL, 5</cite>.
Targ. O. Ex. XXXIV, 20 ותִיקְּפֵיה ed. Berl. (oth. ed., a Y. ותִנְקְ׳; ed. Vien. ותַנְקְ׳ Af.; h. text וערפתו).
Targ. Deut. XXI, 4 (O. ed. Berl. ויַקְּ׳, Af.); a. e.—Part. pass. נְקִיף; f. נְקִיפָא. Ib. 6 (O. ed. Vien. נְקֶפְתָּא).—

<cite ref="Eruvin 53b:9">Erub. 53ᵇ</cite> (enigmatic speech) <he>עלת נַקְפַת בכד ידאון וכ׳</he> the ladle strikes against the jug, shall the eagles fly to their nests (the wine is gone, shall the students go home)?
Targ. Ps. CXL, 12 (Ms. Pe.).—Part. pass. מְנַקַּף.
<cite ref="Berakhot 6a:5">Ber. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>כרעי דמְנַקְּפֵי</he> bruised feet; <cite ref="Yoma 53a">Yoma 53ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="N00182"><he>נְגַף</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to knock the feet against each other, to mince (v. preced. Hif.).
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 3:16">Targ. Is. III, 16</cite> (h. text <cite ref="I00674"><he>טפף</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Chullin 50a:14">Ḥull. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>אַקְּפִינְהוּ ולא וכ׳</he> they compared them, and they did not look alike.

senses.gloss: to knock against, to stumble. Targ. II Esth. IV, 13.—Yoma l. c. מִינַּקְּפִין Ar. ed. Koh., v. נְגַף.
